title: Staff Nurse
questions: Walk me through how you start a shift and take handover on a busy ward.
Tell me about a time a patient's condition changed. What did you notice first, and what did you do?
How do you keep medication rounds safe when you are short-staffed?
Describe how you help a bedridden patient with hygiene, toileting and turning.
How do you talk to a family who is upset while you still have other patients waiting?
Walk me through a clean, useful handover you would give at the end of your shift.
criteria: Safe bedside care and vital-sign judgement

title: ICU / Critical Care Nurse
questions: Walk me through how you monitor a ventilated patient at the start of your shift.
Tell me about an alarm or deterioration you acted on. What did you do first?
How do you give high-alert medicines safely in ICU?
Describe infection control around lines, catheters and a ventilated patient.
How do you work with doctors and the rest of the ICU team during an emergency?
Tell me about a time you caught a near-miss. What changed afterwards?

title: Home Care Nurse
questions: Walk me through a typical home visit from arrival to leaving the house.
How do you keep a patient safe when you are the only nurse in the home?
Tell me about helping with bathing, diaper care or toileting in a home setting.
How do you explain care to family members who are anxious or disagree with the plan?
What would you do if you found the patient worse than the last visit?
How do you document a home visit so the next nurse can continue care safely?
criteria: Independent judgement in a home setting
Hands-on personal care including hygiene and incontinence care
